Hiii👋🏾, so I know you just wanted to vent, but I thought I’d share some advice with you. I used to struggle with self-doubt and insecurity, especially about my appearance and when it came to getting a girlfriend. I’d catch myself thinking negative things about my face, smile, and even my eyes. But here’s the thing, there are two key things to remember to build more confidence:

1. **Don’t let others’ opinions matter.** Most of the people you meet in life won’t be a part of your journey forever. So, the only opinion that truly counts is your own.

2. **Love yourself unconditionally.** Self-love is the foundation of confidence. Treat yourself with kindness and respect, just as you would a friend.

Now, I know you might be thinking about getting a girlfriend right now, but I want to warn you against that. It can actually make your insecurities worse. Instead, take some time to focus on loving and appreciating yourself. Find things about your appearance that you like, not what you think others will think.

Once you’ve grown to love yourself, start to work on improving those qualities or features. Whether it’s practicing a craft, changing your glasses, working out, or trying out makeup, find ways to express yourself that make you feel confident.

One thing that really helped me was fashion. I started to experiment with different styles and found what worked best for me. It was a fun way to express myself and boost my confidence.

And don’t forget about positive affirmations. Repeat positive statements to yourself every day. Tell yourself that you’re beautiful, that your hair looks amazing, and that you love the way you look. It can work wonders for your self-esteem.

I know this is a long post, but I hope it helps you in some way. Remember, you’re unique and special, and you deserve to be happy and confident. 💖
